_selection.criterion: Samples are selected for whether they EXERCISE the pipeline, not for family diversity. The previous corpus was chosen on family labels and produced zero cross-tool correlations on all 7 samples; the MOTIF corpus (n=29) likewise produced zero, with Volatility never triggering. See #426.
_selection.build: corpus_dir entries do not exist until built. Each requires a full pipeline run (detonation, Volatility, Ghidra) with the resulting report.json and persisted Ghidra project copied into corpus_dir. The interpret stage can be disabled for the build; the eval harness supplies its own.
